test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ronak and Riya can do a work in 12 and 18 days, respectively. They worked together for six days and then Ronak left. Find the time taken by Riya to complete the remaining work.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(12, 18) = 36 units.

Ronak's efficiency = 3, Riya's efficiency = 2.

Work done together in 6 days = (3 + 2) × 6 = 30 units.

Remaining work = 36 − 30 = 6 units.

Time for Riya = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Ronak = 12 days

Time taken by Riya = 18 days

Working together period = 6 days

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Combined efficiency of Ronak + Riya = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done in 6 days = Combined efficiency × Number of days

⇒ Work done = 5 × 6 = 30 units

⇒ Remaining work = Total work − Work done

⇒ Remaining work = 36 − 30 = 6 units

⇒ Time taken by Riya = Remaining work ÷ Riya efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is always considered as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the individual time taken by each person to simplify efficiency calculations.

Efficiency Inversion

If two people A and B can do a work in x and y days, the ratio of their efficiencies is y : x.

Pipes and Cisterns

This logic is identical to inlet pipes filling a tank, where work done is the volume of the tank and efficiency is the rate of flow.</p
